title: Aye Ibne Hassan Dulha
body:
Aye ibne hasan dulha aaye ibne hasan dulha, kya so rahe ho utho aayi hai dulhan dulha
Duniya se nayi shaadi karbal mein hui aeysi, the pyaas e baraati sab the pyaase dulhan dulha
Pamaal Aarzoo hai pamaal hai tamanna, pamaal kya hue tum pamaal badan dulha
Sartapa ek sukhan hoon jo aj lab shikhan hoon , ye tere gham mein apna bhooli hoon chalan dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
Jeeti hoon baad tere hain zulm ke ye paihre, kya mujh pe hai qayamat dekho ye rasan dulha
Phir shaane haq dikhaoo tum aake ab chudao, dukhte hain haath mere khulwao rasan dulha
Kya daur-e-aasmaan hai kaisa yeh imtehaan hai, durraon ke sab nashaa hain dukhta hai badan dulha
Balwe mein be rida thi kya tum ko kafan lati, ye ek gham hai mujhko paye na kafan dulha
<<DIVIDER>>
Ta hashr uth gayi hai shaadi Ali ke ghar se, Iqbal ab na honge phir aise dulhan dulha
